claims.text: He is on no congressional witness list. The committee-published witness lists for 26 July 2023 (event 116282), 13 November 2024 (event 117722) and 9 September 2025 name him nowhere, and the printed records of all three hearings contain his name exactly once in total, in the Burlison colloquy.
